title: 第24章 傀儡石像第25章 炼丹房

第24章傀儡石像
其他人是心惊，皮应熊只有痛苦，小猴子和那只豹，都是他了无数心血才驯养出来的，一起相处了好多年。两只驯兽不仅仅是他极大的助力，还是他除了女儿之外最近的亲人，结果短短几天时间，都命丧这密地之中，其中的痛苦可想而知。
不过死都死了，再痛苦也没有用，当务之急是看看眼前有没有危险。死了也好，自己为了大家付出这么多，轮也该轮到别人了，下次再遇到危险，就该其他人走在前面了。
那石像踩死小猴子之后就退了回去，也不知是他们没有看到虎镇嵩他们，还是因为有任务限制，只能守在大门口。
虎镇嵩观察了半天，也想不出有用的办法，扭头问道：“松鹤真人，这石像你能对付吗？”
松鹤老道摇了摇头，道：“如果是两个跟他们实力相当的人，老道就算是打不过两人联手，也有足够的把握逃走，若是能够引走一个，剩下的我有足够把握战胜，可这两个石像，老道就没有办法了。”
石像的速度倒不算特别快，也就跟杜成金和钱半仙差不多，虎镇嵩和松鹤老道这种高手有了防备，也能够躲过石像刚才那一脚，若是两尊石像同时攻击，那就不是他们能应付的了。
石像力大无穷，又坚固无比，普通的手段根本就伤害不到，面对石像只能被动躲避，却还不了手。而且两尊石像守在门口那狭小的范围，相互配合之下，那就更难对付了。
“空寂大师呢？”虎镇嵩又问道。
空寂大师略微思索了一下，道：“我的开山掌号称开碑裂石，但那是在全力击打静止石碑的情况下，而且是一掌开缝，两掌断石，三掌才能完全碎裂。这石像不知是何材质的，又能反击躲避，估计我的开山掌在这里没什么用。”
如果门口的是两个人，在场的起码有四五个与他们实力相当，哪怕再厉害一点，大家一起冲上去围殴也能取胜。换成了石像，他们就只能干瞪眼了，你伤不到对方，对方却能伤到你，只能挨打不能还手，再没有逼着更憋屈的了。而且石像就守在门口那狭小的范围，上去的人多了也没用，反而影响发挥。
这些虎镇嵩也想到了，连实力最高的松鹤老道和空寂大师都没有办法，其他人就更不用说了，就连前面表现比较出众的青阳也想不出什么好主意。只有解决了两尊石像，才能进一步想办法打开那石门，如今连这两尊石像都解决不了，就更没机会打开石门了，难道就这么无功而返不成？
就在这时，杜成金道：“虎帮主，这两尊石像我想到了一个办法，只是没有试过，不知道能不能成。”
“真的？你有办法？快说！”虎镇嵩都已经绝望了，却没想到实力不高，而且还断了一臂的杜成金却说有办法。
杜成金道：“我们盗墓的时候，经常会遇到挖掘爆破等事情，比如封死的石门，或者落下的石闸，所以震天雷也是我们盗墓者的必备之物。我的震天雷是自己精心制作的，效果比别人的更好，如果石像是普通石头做成的，应该可以把它炸毁。只是这些石像会活动，我只有三颗震天雷，不知道能不能起作用。”
这倒也是，石像不可能站在那里等死，你把震天雷扔过去，若是那石像躲开了，岂不是白白浪费掉一颗震天雷？在这种密地，什么东西都要省着点，用完了可没地方补充。
“哈哈哈，这个好办，老道我前段时间收集了一些特制的树胶，用火化开之后粘性强大无比，你那震天雷上抹一些，直接把震天雷沾到石像身上不就行了？”松鹤老道大笑道。
“对，我看那石像行动笨拙，相互之间的配合并不默契，若是把震天雷沾到石像后背，他们肯定取不下来。”青阳在旁边道。
三个臭皮匠赛过诸葛亮，大家集思广益，果然就找到了对付那石像的办法。杜成金是盗墓的行家，才会准备震天雷这种东西，而松鹤老道浪迹江湖，坑蒙拐骗无所不为，身上才会有强力树胶这种冷门的东西。也幸亏虎镇嵩把他们都找来了，否则的话真的要束手无策了。
商量好了办法，大家说干就干，杜成金取出两枚震天雷，松鹤老道也拿出一块树胶，用火折子把树胶烤化之后，抹在了震天雷的外面，然后又打开震天雷的保护盖，准备工作就做好了。

剩下的事情就简单多了，两枚震天雷，松鹤老道与空寂大师每人一个，他们悄悄的来到石像的背后，把震天雷粘在石像之上，然后就施展轻身术快速的后退。两人的功力本就是最高的，又是在后背偷偷施为，等那石像转身的时候，他们已经退到了两丈之外。
与此同时，两人又各自弹出一枚石子，正好击打在石像后背的震天雷上。震天雷的保护盖已经打开，稍微有震动就会爆炸，更何况是被两位高人用石子弹中，只听轰轰两声巨响，两尊石像的后背炸裂开来，之后扑通一声倒在了地上。
待到周围硝烟散去，大家再看地上那两尊石像，其中一尊的后背的部位被炸开了一个碗大的洞口，并且有一颗青色的晶石掉落出来，那石像倒在地上不能动弹。而另外一尊，后背的洞口稍小一些，不过也露出了里面的青色晶石，只是没有掉落出来，那石像还在挣扎。
在场的都是老江湖了，他们虽然不认识那青色晶石有何用，但是也能判断出来，晶石的作用应该就是为傀儡石像提供能量的。
趁他病要他命，虎镇华在第一时间就祭出了两把飞刀，连续斩在了石像后背的洞口部位，把那枚青色的晶石也击落到了地上，之后那尊石像又颤动了两下，也彻底不动了。
总算是大功告成了，虎镇华试探着往前走了两步，来到石像的边上，等确认那两尊石像真的像是死了一样，不会再活过来，他才弯腰捡起地上的两枚青色晶石，拿回来交给了虎镇嵩。
（本章完）

Chapter 24 Puppet Stone Statue
Others were frightened, but Pi Yingxiong was only in pain. The little monkey and the leopard were both tamed by him after countless efforts, and they had been together for many years. The two tamed beasts were not only a great help to him, but also his closest relatives besides his daughter. As a result, they both died in this secret place in just a few days. The pain involved can be imagined.
But death is already dead, no matter how painful it is, it is useless. The top priority is to see if there is any danger in front of you. No matter if he dies, after he has sacrificed so much for everyone, it's someone else's turn and it's someone else's turn. Next time he encounters danger, it's someone else's turn to take the lead.
The stone statue stepped back after trampling the little monkey to death. I don't know if they didn't see Hu Zhensong or the others, or because they had mission restrictions and could only guard the gate.
Hu Zhensong observed for a long time, but couldn't think of any useful method. He turned around and asked, "Master Songhe, can you deal with this stone statue?"
Old Taoist Songhe shook his head and said: "If there are two people with the same strength as them, even if the old Taoist cannot defeat the two of them together, he will still be confident enough to escape. If I can lure one away, I will be confident enough to defeat the rest. But with these two stone statues, the old Taoist has no choice."
The speed of the stone statue is not particularly fast, it is about the same as that of Du Chengjin and Qian Banxian. Experts like Hu Zhensong and Songhe Laodao are prepared and can avoid the stone statue's kick just now. If the two stone statues attack at the same time, it will not be something they can handle.
The stone statue is extremely powerful and extremely strong, and cannot be harmed by ordinary means. Facing the stone statue, it can only be passively avoided, but it cannot be attacked. Moreover, the two stone statues were guarding the small area at the door. If they cooperated with each other, it would be even more difficult to deal with them.
"Where is Master Kongji?" Hu Zhensong asked again.
Master Kong Ji thought for a moment and said: "My Mountain Opening Palm is known as opening a monument and cracking a stone, but that is when hitting a static stone tablet with all my strength, and it requires one palm to open a crack, two palms to break the stone, and three palms to completely shatter it. I don't know what kind of material this stone statue is made of, and it can counterattack and dodge. I guess my Mountain Opening Palm is useless here."
If there are two people at the door, there will be at least four or five people present who are of equal strength to them. Even if they are a little more powerful, they can win if they all rush forward and fight together. If it were a stone statue, they could only stare. You can't hurt the other person, but the other person can hurt you. They can only be beaten without being able to fight back. There is no way to force them to be more aggrieved. Moreover, the stone statue is guarding the small area at the door. It will be useless if more people come up, but it will affect the performance.
These Hu Zhensong also thought that even the most powerful Master Songhe and Master Kongji couldn't do anything, let alone the others. Even Qingyang, who had performed better in the past, couldn't come up with any good ideas. Only by solving the two stone statues can we further find a way to open the stone door. Now that we can't even solve the two stone statues, we have no chance to open the stone door. Is it just like this that we just failed in vain?
At this moment, Du Chengjin said: "Master Tiger Gang, I have thought of a way to build these two stone statues, but I haven't tried it yet, so I don't know if it can work."
"Really? Do you have a way? Say it quickly!" Hu Zhensong was already desperate, but he didn't expect that Du Chengjin, who was not very strong and had a broken arm, said there was a way.
Du Chengjin said: "When we rob tombs, we often encounter things such as excavation and blasting, such as sealed stone gates or falling stone gates, so the thunderbolts are also a must-have for us tomb robbers. My thunderbolts are carefully made by myself, and the effect is better than others. If the stone statues are made of ordinary stones, they should be able to blow them up. But these stone statues can move. I only have three thunderbolts, so I don't know if they will work."
This is true, the stone statue cannot stand there waiting to die. If you throw the thunderbolt over, if the stone statue avoids it, wouldn't it be a waste of thunderbolt? In a dense place like this, you have to save everything.Be careful, there is no place to replenish it when it is used up.
"Hahaha, this is easy to do. I collected some special gum some time ago. It is very sticky after being burned. Isn't it enough to put some of it on your thunderbolt and directly stick it on the stone statue?" Old Master Songhe said with a laugh.
"Yes, I see that the stone statue moves clumsily, and the cooperation between them is not tacit. If the Thunderbolt gets on the back of the stone statue, they will definitely not be able to remove it." Qingyang said from the side.
The three cobblers defeated Zhuge Liang, and everyone brainstormed and found a way to deal with the stone statue. Du Chengjin is an expert in tomb robbing, so he can prepare things like thunderbolts, while Songhe Lao Dao wanders around the world and does everything in deceit and abduction, so he has unpopular things like strong gum on his body. Fortunately, Hu Zhensong found them all, otherwise we would really be helpless.
After discussing the method, everyone just went ahead. Du Chengjin took out two thunderbolts, and Old Taoist Songhe also took out a piece of gum. After baking the gum with a fire stick, he smeared it on the outside of the thunderbolts. Then he opened the protective cover of the thunderbolts, and the preparations were done.
The rest of the matter was much simpler. There were two thunderbolts, one each for Master Songhe and Master Kongji. They quietly came to the back of the stone statue, stuck the thunderbolts on the stone statue, and then used the light body technique to quickly retreat. The two people's skills were the highest, and they were secretly performing their actions from behind. By the time the stone statue turned around, they had already retreated two feet away.
At the same time, the two of them each ejected a stone, which hit the thunderbolt on the back of the stone statue. The protective cover of Zhentian Lei has been opened, and it will explode at the slightest vibration, not to mention that it was hit by two experts with stone bullets. There were only two loud bangs, and the backs of the two stone statues exploded, and then they fell to the ground with a plop.
When the smoke cleared around them, everyone looked at the two stone statues on the ground. A hole as big as a bowl was opened in the back of one of them, and a blue crystal fell out. The stone statue fell to the ground and could not move. On the other one, the hole on the back was slightly smaller, but the blue crystal stone inside was also exposed, but it did not fall out. The stone statue was still struggling.
The people present were all Lao Jianghu. Although they didn't know the use of the cyan crystal, they could tell that the function of the crystal should be to provide energy for the puppet stone statue.
Taking advantage of the fact that his illness was threatening to kill him, Hu Zhenhua immediately used two flying knives and struck the hole on the back of the stone statue one after another, knocking the blue crystal stone down to the ground. After that, the stone statue trembled twice more and became completely motionless.
Finally done, Hu Zhenhua took two tentative steps forward and came to the edge of the stone statues. After confirming that the two stone statues really seemed to be dead and would not come back to life, he bent down and picked up the two cyan crystals on the ground, took them back and handed them to Hu Zhensong.
(End of chapter)
